subject: Phase 100110: Dense and Lexical Index Pipelines
verdict_justification: The developer delivered all core Phase 100110 capabilities: the clio-index crate with sidecar HTTP client, transactional outbox worker, rebuild hooks, and dual-backend vector/lexical search with extensive test coverage meeting all gates (98.85% functions, 98.50% lines aggregate, 0 files below 90%). The adversarial review identified two important functional/operational edge-case issues (zero-limit search returns 1 hit on IndexStore, and single-IP DNS resolution in HTTP connect failing on dual-stack localhost) and four minor issues (module headers on 7 test files, dead widening loop, eager rebuild page buffering, and missing Content-Length parsing).

findings.title: IndexStore search primitives return 1 hit when limit is 0
findings.recommendation: Add an early guard checking `if limit == 0 { return Ok(Vec::new()); }` at the start of `dense_search` and `lexical_search` on both SqliteStore and PostgresStore.

findings.title: HTTP client connects only to first resolved IP address, failing on dual-stack localhost
findings.recommendation: Iterate through all candidate addresses returned by `to_socket_addrs()` and try `TcpStream::connect_timeout` on each candidate until one succeeds or all fail.

findings.title: Missing AGENTS.md mandatory module header structure in 7 newly created Rust files
findings.recommendation: Add the required module header format (`//! # Responsibility`, `//! ## Owns`, `//! ## Does not own`, `//! ## Boundary`) to all newly created test and test-support modules.

findings.title: Dead widening loop and potential duplicate accumulation in SqliteStore::lexical_search
findings.recommendation: Remove the redundant loop or initialize `out` inside the loop body, relying on SQL-level filtering and limits.

findings.title: Eager full-bank ID buffering in visible_pages during rebuild sweeps
findings.recommendation: Stream or paginate item IDs on demand rather than buffering all pages for the entire bank into memory upfront.

findings.title: HTTP client reads until EOF without checking Content-Length header
findings.recommendation: Parse `Content-Length` from the HTTP response head and terminate reading once the exact byte count is received.

issues.title: IndexStore search primitives return 1 hit when limit is 0
issues.why_it_matters: Callers requesting zero results (e.g. for existence checks or pagination probes) receive an unexpected match.
issues.impact: Violates expected query limit semantics for callers directly invoking IndexStore trait methods.
issues.proposed_fix: Add an early check `if limit == 0 { return Ok(Vec::new()); }` at the start of dense_search and lexical_search on both SqliteStore and PostgresStore.

issues.title: HTTP client connects only to first resolved IP address, failing on dual-stack localhost
issues.why_it_matters: Connecting to http://localhost:<port> fails if localhost resolves to IPv6 ::1 first while the sidecar is bound only to IPv4 127.0.0.1.
issues.impact: Standard development and container setups where TEI listens on 127.0.0.1 fail to connect if host is specified as 'localhost'.
issues.proposed_fix: Iterate through the SocketAddr iterator from to_socket_addrs() and attempt connect_timeout on each until one succeeds.

issues.title: Missing AGENTS.md mandatory module header structure in 7 newly created Rust files
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS.md mandates the Responsibility/Owns/Boundary docblock header on every Rust file.
issues.impact: Non-compliance with repository file header standards.
issues.proposed_fix: Add the required module header format including //! # Responsibility, //! ## Owns, //! ## Does not own, and //! ## Boundary to all 7 files.

issues.title: Dead widening loop and potential duplicate accumulation in SqliteStore::lexical_search
issues.why_it_matters: The loop in sqlite_index.rs::lexical_search is dead code because SQL filtering handles limits directly. If ever reached, it would duplicate results.
issues.impact: Misleading code structure that mimics dense vector widening where it does not apply.
issues.proposed_fix: Remove the loop and query directly with limit as parameter.

issues.title: Eager full-bank ID buffering in visible_pages during rebuild sweeps
issues.why_it_matters: Rebuilding indexes for a bank with tens of thousands of items buffers all item IDs in memory at once.
issues.impact: Unnecessary memory consumption during reindex operations on large banks.
issues.proposed_fix: Stream or paginate item IDs lazily during rebuild sweeps.

issues.title: HTTP client reads until EOF without checking Content-Length header
issues.why_it_matters: If a sidecar server sends a full Content-Length response but delays socket shutdown, read_response blocks until the timeout.
issues.impact: Potential latency spikes if connected to HTTP/1.1 servers that don't immediately close sockets on Connection: close.
issues.proposed_fix: Parse Content-Length from response headers and terminate reading once expected bytes have been consumed.

strengths: Strict compliance with zero-new-dependencies rule by implementing a clean std::net::TcpStream HTTP client.
Strong decoupling of leaf write path from sidecar embedding via transactional outbox (index_pending).
Comprehensive unit and integration test coverage for failure modes, backoff, and dimension mismatches.
Dual-backend parity test suite executing identical contract assertions on both SQLite and Postgres.
regrets: Did not add module header documentation to the test files before completing developer turn.
process_changes: Automate pre-commit verification of file headers across all files including test modules.
plan_1hr: Fix F-01 by adding `if limit == 0 { return Ok(Vec::new()); }` to `dense_search` and `lexical_search` in `sqlite_index.rs` and `postgres_index.rs`.
Fix F-02 in `crates/clio-index/src/http.rs` by looping over `to_socket_addrs()` candidates in `connect()`.
Fix F-03 by adding the mandatory AGENTS.md module header docblocks to all 7 newly created Rust files.
Fix F-04 by cleaning up the dead widening loop in `SqliteStore::lexical_search`.
plan_unlimited: Implement streaming rebuild sweeps in `IndexCoordinator` that process pages lazily without full-bank buffering in memory.
Enhance the raw TCP HTTP client to parse Content-Length headers and reuse connections with keep-alive, or adopt an approved minimal HTTP library like `ureq`.
